Item Class: Skill Gems
Rarity: Gem
Glacial Hammer
--------
Attack, Melee, Strike, Cold
Level: 12
Cost: 8 Mana
Attack Damage: 400.7% of base
Effectiveness of Added Damage: 400%
--------
Requirements:
Level: 40
Str: 92
--------
Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to cold damage. If a non-unique enemy is frozen and is on less than one third life, they will shatter when hit by Glacial Hammer. If striking three times in a row, the third strike will freeze enemies more easily. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.
--------
100% of Physical Damage Converted to Cold Damage
25% chance to Freeze enemies
Every third successive strike Freezes enemies as though dealing 310% more Damage
21% increased Effect of Cold Ailments
35% increased Duration of Cold Ailments
--------
Experience: 1061223/1061223
--------
Next-level requirements:
Level: 44
Str: 100
--------
Place into an item socket to gain this skill. Right click to remove from a socket.
